title: Marlinspike Partners Closes $127 Million Fund II to Expand Investments in AI and National Security Technologies
description: Marlinspike Partners has expanded its investment platform after successfully closing its second venture capital fund with commitments totaling $127 million. The new fund is designed to accelerate investment in emerging companies developing technologies that serve both commercial markets and national security priorities.
